Personalized, engraved, custom-name, initial, birthstone, and made-to-order pieces are final sale unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect.

Standard, non-personalized items may be eligible for return within 14 days of delivery when they are unused, unworn, undamaged, and returned with original packaging. Please contact North & Pearl before sending anything back so support can review eligibility and provide the correct next step.
